intuition: Keep keys grouped by count in increasing order so the first and last buckets expose the minimum and maximum.

brute_force.approach: Maintain key counts in a map and scan all keys whenever a minimum or maximum key is requested.
brute_force.time: inc O(1), dec O(1), getMinKey O(n), getMaxKey O(n)

optimal.approach: Maintain a doubly linked list of count buckets, with a set of keys at each count and a key-to-bucket map.
optimal.time: inc O(1), dec O(1), getMinKey O(1), getMaxKey O(1)

edge_cases: Decrementing a key from count one removes it.
An empty structure returns an empty string for either key query.
